name: 14076-vlmburst-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-FP8 -- ungated. FP8 e4m3 with dynamic activation scaling; `lm_head` and the vision tower stay bf16. Not interchangeable with another 4B VLM: the setup is written around this checkpoint's processor geometry.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- a 4B model on one GPU.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration -- 36 text layers, GQA 32 query over 8 KV heads, hidden 2560; 24-layer ViT, patch 16, 2x2 merge, so a 1280x720 image is 880 tokens.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: Two zipped guidellm synthetic sources merged into one `/v1/chat/completions` request: `synthetic_text` with a single shared 500-token prefix plus 600 prompt tokens and a 20-token generation, and `synthetic_image` at the `720p` preset -- one gradient JPEG of exactly (1280, 720) per request, so every image is byte-different. About 2000 tokens in and exactly 20 out, with `ignore_eos: true`. Every `*_stdev` is unset and must stay unset: identical request sizes and a pinned output length are what keep the 128 in-flight requests finishing in the same step and resubmitting together. Radix cache is off, so every request pays full prefill.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering questions about 720p screenshots with short replies, 128 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `sglang serve` CLI form. Every key must be a scalar and a real ServerArgs field at the
# pinned commit; nested blocks are dropped by the reader, so keep it flat.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-FP8
enable-multimodal: true
mm-attention-backend: sdpa
context-length: 4096
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
page-size: 16
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3

# Required, not cosmetic: with prefix caching on, the 500-token shared prefix is reused and every
# request becomes cheaper than the one this setup serves.
disable-radix-cache: true

stream-interval: 300
